# KibaOS

> KibaOS is a free, user-friendly Linux desktop developed by Kiba Labs, LLC. It pairs the KibaDE desktop environment — based on the Ash shell of ChromiumOS, built from the Lumen fork of Chromium — with an Arch Linux base. KibaOS ships with the Chromium browser and the Apps and Games store, and its goal is to be as simple to use as possible.

Key facts:
- Desktop environment: KibaDE, based on the Ash shell of ChromiumOS, built from the Lumen fork of Chromium
- Base: Arch Linux
- Browser: Chromium
- Software: Apps and Games store, Files app, everyday tools (calculator, notes)
- License: GNU GPL v3, free forever
- Privacy: KibaOS does not collect or sell your data
- Updates: quiet background updates
- Trial: run it live from an 8 GB USB stick without installing
- Tagline: "Fast. Simple. Limitless."
- Company: Kiba Labs, LLC (© 2026), founded in Aurora, Missouri, USA; contact corporate@kibaos.com
- Downloads: https://sourceforge.net/projects/kibaos/
- Source code: https://github.com/KibaLabsLLC/KibaOS
